status: partial implementation, local checks passed; not versioned or published as 1.71
scope: Reject an account switch on an already authenticated connection before consulting credential storage; retain the original rejection text and original identity.
Do not start registration/login credential work or consume a reconnect token on a closed or retired recipient.
Recheck retirement after acquiring the login/resume character-work lock before allowing authentication to revive that transport.

regression.before: The account-switch test reached DB.Authenticate and failed with the intentionally absent test database, proving the rejection previously came after a credential query.
regression.newCases: Seven negative cases: one cross-account login, closed/retired login and registration, and closed/retired resume with preservation of a valid one-use token.
regression.after: Focused account, token, queue, character-owner, session-activity, admin-admission and inbound-protocol checks passed under the Go race detector in 2.582 seconds.
regression.protocolGate: An initial top-level guard failed the existing dispatcher AST contract. The guards were moved inside the three auth cases; the policy-coverage assertion was not weakened. Formatting and whitespace checks passed.

limits: No production account, password, session, recovery request or administrator action was performed.
Credential requirements, cross-connection authentication budgets, hash-work admission and recovery delivery remain separate unfinished work.
The pending owner recovery-delivery choice is not inferred; no SMTP or password-reset bypass was introduced.
Prepared releases 1.64 through 1.70 remain unpublished until ordered predecessor acceptance; 1.63 is currently in deployment.
